verdicts.reason: The two are nearly identical three-column banners, and both have the same flaw: the '7 days free' fine print sits far below the CTA, cut off from its button and not aligned to the button's left edge. That leaves an awkward empty band and a ragged right column. A gets the slight edge for a more comfortable headline margin and a CTA closer to the vertical centre, though its phone nearly touches the top and bottom edges. B's headline sits tight against the left edge, and its CTA rides high above the headline's centre line, so it looks less balanced.
